title: McGraw Hill, Inc. to Participate in an Investor Call Hosted by Goldman Sachs
summary: McGraw Hill , Inc. (NYSE: MH) today announced that Philip Moyer, President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors, will participate in a call hosted by George Tong, an equity research analyst with Goldman Sachs. The call will take place on Friday, June 12, 2026, at 2:00 PM ET. The discussion will focus on McGraw Hill in the context of Goldman Sachs’ AI Resilience framework in the Information Services sector. To register for the call, please contact your Goldman Sachs representative or christina.cikowski@gs.com .
